blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Pacific Douglas. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Pacific Douglas, South Surrey and White Rock: 25 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 4 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 16%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 6 of 9 South Surrey and White Rock communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Pacific Douglas rose from 22 in June to 25 in September, and 11 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 4.2% of South Surrey and White Rock’s 593 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Pacific Douglas?
Pacific Douglas also had 39 houses listed and 6 sold in September, against 25 condos and townhomes listed. The Pacific Douglas houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Pacific Douglas?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 25 condos and townhomes listed in Pacific Douglas. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Pacific Douglas a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Pacific Douglas had a sales ratio of 16%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Pacific Douglas from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 11 condos and townhomes sold in Pacific Douglas over those 4 months, out of 375 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
